text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Daishoten has ended. The Winning 
Live became a magnificent performance that 
will remain in people's memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Smart Falcon voiced her bitter 
frustration, feeling she hadn't matched 
the excitement of the recent Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other dirt Umamusume are content here, 
knowing nothing of the glory of turf G1s. 
If so, as one who knows the difference, 
she must lead them to those greater 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next target is the February Stakes. 
Seeing Smart Falcon looking tense and 
overly determined, her trainer reminded 
her not to push herself too hard.
